summary: KLX Energy Services Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 24, 2026, announcing the commencement of its previously disclosed subscription rights offering. Eligible holders of common stock and certain warrants received one transferable subscription right per share (or underlying share) as of the August 21, 2026 record date, each allowing purchase of 3.885 shares at $1.49 per share. The offering expires September 23, 2026, and rights trade on Nasdaq under KLXER. Subscription rights are subject to a 9.995% beneficial ownership cap, with backstop parties excepted. Proceeds of up to $31 million are earmarked. Watch for subscription uptake, backstop participation, and potential price support.
